# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers XML comments to reference Microsoft Learn .NET API pages in the pattern https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.office.core.<interface-or-member>?view=office-pia, including member-specific URLs for properties and methods.
- For `UpdateXmlComments.py`, when a strict bookmark isn't found for a function member, also try a bookmark with `[]` suffix (e.g., `International[]`).
